{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
duplicate_patients = df['patient_id'].duplicated(keep=False)
duplicate_count = duplicate_patients.sum()

df_with_duplicates = df[duplicate_patients]

# Check how many patients have multiple sample_seq entries
patient_sample_seq_counts = df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].count()
retested_patients = patient_sample_seq_counts[patient_sample_seq_counts > 1]

# Print findings
print(f"Total rows: {len(df)}")
print(f"Total unique patient_id: {df['patient_id'].nunique()}")
print(f"Number of patients with multiple sample_seq entries: {len(retested_patients)}")
print(f"Number of duplicate patient_id rows: {duplicate_count}")

# Confirm the deduplication logic: keep row with highest sample_seq per patient
df_dedup = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

print(f"After deduplication (keeping highest sample_seq per patient): {len(df_dedup)} patients")

# Check if the data has 3 sites as stated in premise
print(f"Unique sites: {df['site'].unique()}")"}
